subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do maintainers approve advancing the credentialed `openai/codex-action` workflows to revision `52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` after a source and trust audit?
rationale: This action executes in workflows that receive an OpenAI API key, so accepting the new executable revision is a repository security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical Dependabot repair.

options.title: Audit and prove before merge
options.body: Verify the new action revision against the approved source/release and attach redacted output from an affected workflow before refreshing and merging this PR.

options.title: Retain the existing Codex pin
options.body: Split the grouped update and defer only the Codex action revision until its trust review is complete.

options.title: Accept the revision risk
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly approve the revision without further proof, accepting the credentialed workflow supply-chain risk.

recommendation.title: Audit and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Verify the new action revision against the approved source/release and attach redacted output from an affected workflow before refreshing and merging this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR timeline provides the strongest maintainer-routing signal for a workflow security decision, although direct file-history ownership was not established.
